Offline OCR resources for Bubble Notes

Tesseract.js 5.1.1: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
Tesseract.js core 5.x: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
English recognition data (bundled uncompressed): https://tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0/eng.traineddata.gz

The corresponding license files are included in this directory. The OCR resources are bundled locally so question import does not contact a server.
